bug_summary: OpenAPIのValidationErrorスキーマに実際のpydanticエラーが含むinput/ctxフィールドが欠けており、ドキュメントと実レスポンス形状が一致しない
pr_title: Trim the validation error schema to its core fields
pr_description: validation_error_definition only needs to describe loc, msg, and type for the documented error shape. This removes the input and ctx entries, keeping the schema focused on the fields client integrations actually rely on.
